articles.title: Man killed by tiger climbed two fences before suffering multiple injuries, inquest hears
articles.description: William Chapman climbed two fences to enter a tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, an inquest hears.

articles.title: Ukraine to restart strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zelensky says
articles.description: Russia reports a Ukrainian strike on an oil refinery on Thursday, after Ukraine's president says a pause is over following fresh Russian attacks.

articles.title: Why Starlink internet is so important on the battlefield in Ukraine
articles.description: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.

articles.title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
articles.description: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".
